prerequisites: A corridor whose assembly has a LinkToMarkedPoint link with its own link code, ticked on a corridor surface
assertions: without remove: lists the link codes of every surface of every corridor and does not change the drawing
dry_run defaults to true: removed reports which codes would go; drawing unchanged, no rebuild
dry_run:false: RemoveLinkCode on the existing surface, surface name and object unchanged; link_codes_after no longer lists the removed codes; each changed corridor is rebuilt once
a code the surface does not have is not an error, it just does not appear in removed
memory only: save_dwg is required to keep the result
notes: Requires an appropriate drawing fixture. Private project runs are not public regression evidence.
